NHS governance records show aggregated public feedback, direct public-representative participation, repeated challenge to AI consent and data-use thresholds, and observed programme response without yet proving a binding public veto.

Palantir shareholder proposals created explicit governance counterfactuals, while the Class F formula and actual vote record make founder voting privilege observable without proving how a one-share-one-vote counterfactual would have resolved.
Brave1 publicly describes high automation with operator target selection and an attack-cancel path, while the negative-validation, incident, recall, injury, and remedy denominator remains absent.
Technology-worker letters supply direct preventive challenge and evidence-custody claims, but not yet demonstrated compulsory power.

The cross-system monopoly proposition remains candidate-only until repeated rights-holder identity, direct deployment-specific subject voice, consequence, remedy, comparator, and causal error-benefit chains are complete.

fanout.title: DCGS positive control: complete the preventive burden-shift record
fanout.question: Did the judicial intervention materially change the gate, burden, option set, and final acquisition path?
fanout.falsifier: The post-judgment acquisition proceeded without material gate change or the later award was wholly independent.
fanout.stopping_rule: Close when the burden shift, option set, causal limit, and comparator record are terminally adjudicated.

fanout.title: Army enterprise: test continuity thresholds against observed exit
fanout.question: Were continuity, migration, rebuilding, and reaccreditation thresholds independently validated against an operated alternative?
fanout.falsifier: Observed replacement or phased substitution is rapid, proportionate, and mission-preserving.
fanout.stopping_rule: Close when every continuity assertion has a source, comparator, observed test, and terminal disposition.

fanout.title: NGC2: reconstruct target confidence, human veto, and abort
fanout.question: What information, confidence, time, and authority did soldiers and commanders possess before target-to-effect action?
fanout.falsifier: The stack did not materially inform the effect or human operators possessed no meaningful veto.
fanout.stopping_rule: Close after one full target-to-effect trace and a matched legacy or alternate-system comparator.

fanout.title: NGC2: freeze component denominator and common-baseline alternatives
fanout.question: Did competition remain real at the common data baseline and critical-component level after program-level awards?
fanout.falsifier: Common components were competitively replaceable and alternatives generated comparable operating evidence.
fanout.stopping_rule: Close when program and component counterfactuals are separately adjudicated.

fanout.title: ImmigrationOS: acquire one person-level inference-to-consequence file
fanout.question: Did system data or prioritization materially shape one apprehension, detention, departure, removal, or nonaction, and could the person stop or correct it?
fanout.falsifier: Complete cases show the system supplied no material inference or effective pre-action review prevented erroneous consequence.
fanout.stopping_rule: Close only with a complete causal chain or an explicit bounded non-link.

fanout.title: ICE: map source-to-system evidence custody and interfaces
fanout.question: Who can reconstruct the complete enforcement decision across source systems, ICM, ImmigrationOS, users, supervisors, and review bodies?
fanout.falsifier: ICE independently holds and can disclose a complete, versioned, auditable chain.
fanout.stopping_rule: Close when every decisive field, transformation, user action, and custodian is mapped.

fanout.title: NHS: test patient standing and use-case governance
fanout.question: Can a patient or service user contest the category, purpose, or action before consequence, not merely correct data afterward?
fanout.falsifier: No consequential patient-facing action exists or effective pre-action standing is demonstrated.
fanout.stopping_rule: Close with one complete use-case and subject-standing file.

fanout.title: NHS: observe migration and practical substitution
fanout.question: Did an alternate supplier actually assume data, product, workflow, users, accreditation, and operating responsibility with continuity and proportionate cost?
fanout.falsifier: The alternative completed effective operation with no material incumbent dependency.
fanout.stopping_rule: Close when the product-level and enterprise-level exit propositions are separately terminal.

fanout.title: Brave1: build validation, failure, error, and benefit ledger
fanout.question: Who sets validation thresholds, who bears failed-model or battlefield error, and who receives the resulting data, orders, IP, and standards position?
fanout.falsifier: Benefits and errors are proportionately allocated with effective preventive stopping authority.
fanout.stopping_rule: Close after positive and negative validation paths are both represented.

fanout.title: Erebor: resolve regulatory thresholds, investor rights, and matched comparators

required_objects: matched de novo approvals and failures

fanout.stopping_rule: Close when public gate, private rights, operating traffic, and comparators are reconciled.

fanout.stopping_rule: Close with one deployment-specific constitutional chain.

stages.purpose: Record the perceived invariant in the human observer’s own language before normalization.
Define scope, actors, time, system, alternative explanations, and maximum evidentiary ceiling.
Decompose the shape into exact transitions that would have to be true.
Name the record, custodian, lawful route, comparator, falsifier, and stopping rule for each transition.
Search support, contradiction, ordinary controls, non-links, failed paths, and unavailable records symmetrically.
Assign support, candidate-only, non-link, falsification, acquisition, restriction, or unavailability without averaging.
Version the original claim, correction, surviving mechanism, and reason for every change.

operating_law: An unfinished proof chain is not proof that the observer perceived nothing.
An early pattern signal is not a finding and receives no exemption from falsification.
The final five percent is often a separate custody and causal-join problem and must be named rather than hand-waved.
Model or institutional resistance is evidence about the available ontology, not evidence that the substantive claim is true.
The strongest validation is survival under factual correction, comparator review, and adversarial acquisition.
Original language and later refined concepts must remain linked so the project can distinguish foresight from retrospective rewriting.
